### Tool and revision

- Toolkit commit:
- PowerShell / OS / architecture:
- PowerCLI versions, if relevant (or Not installed):
- Product/build and endpoint kind, if authorized functional testing occurred:

### Validation category

Static analysis / offline simulation / authorized functional test (choose one).

### Reproduction

Sanitized invocation and minimal invented fixture. No real hostnames, users, addresses, paths, resource IDs, license keys, tokens or credential objects.

### Expected and actual result

Include errors, Unknown/NotRun states and whether partial data was returned. Share only sanitized error identifiers; keep raw logs private.

### Evidence and scope

State authorization and tested scope without identifying the target or account. Does this occur without PowerCLI? Which exact combination was tested? Do not generalize compatibility.

### Safety review

Confirm manual review of text, fixtures and screenshots before submission. For suspected exposed secrets, use SECURITY.md privately instead of this public template.
